content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Matriculation (10th) pass Other conditions: Must be a resident of Bhojpur district. Must be physically and mentally healthy. Must have a good moral character. Must have interest in social service and no political affiliation. Preference given to applicants with computer knowledge. Desirable: Teachers, retired government servants, senior citizens, members of self-help groups, Maitri groups, Jeevika members, Anganwadi workers, doctors, students, members of non-governmental organizations and clubs.

DLSA Bhojpur Para Legal Volunteer Job Description
content_sections.text: Para Legal Volunteers are expected to perform the following duties in their respective areas: Create legal awareness and provide legal assistance to victims in coordination with DLSA Bhojpur. Act as a bridge between the public and the authority. Manage legal aid clinics and execute any other legal service work assigned by the DLSA Bhojpur office.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Honorarium is paid for specific days when work is assigned by DLSA. Not a government job appointment, selected through panel for one year tenure with possible extension.

content_sections.heading: How Will DLSA Bhojpur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview by District Judge-cum-Chairman, DLSA Interview conducted by District Judge-cum-Chairman, DLSA at the chamber in Civil Court, Bhojpur, Arrah.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested educational certificates Passport size photograph Self-addressed envelope with Rs. 55 postage stamp

Affix a self-attested passport size photograph on the application and admit card. Enclose a self-addressed stamped envelope worth Rs. 55. Send the application by registered post or speed post to the office address before the last date. Make sure it reaches by 19 November 2026.
